title: 14 Editing
subtitle: Artboards, the objects inside them, layout, text, shapes, images, components and the inspector — Studio site and Alligators brand
brief: jeste me doslo ze tam vubec neni navrh jak bude vypadat prace s artboards a annotations, jak bude vypadat ta samotna editace a objekty atd. — this canvas covers artboards + objects + editing (annotations: 15 Annotations). Selecting, resizing (preset snapping, Fits content vs Fixed), arranging with smart guides, tidy up, the artboard menu, rename in place; entering frames, multi-select, nudge, frame selection, order, lock, hide, Layers in sync; auto layout with token gap/padding, drag-to-reorder with a slot, free placement with constraints, Convert layout to absolute; text editing, styles, overrides and detach in Czech; shapes with per-corner radius, Pen; image place + crop; components from the Design system with overrides, variant swap, detach; the whole inspector; and edge cases — AI and you in one artboard, Tereza on the same object, a 6000 px page, undo across AI, ⌘/ on a selection resolving in place, a paste from Figma, keyboard only.

artboards.label: 1 · Select an artboard
artboards.note: Name turns azure with its size, eight handles, the artboard inspector: preset, size, height, clip, fill, layout, export.

artboards.label: 2 · Resize — snaps to presets
artboards.note: Dragging an edge clicks onto Laptop 1280 on the preset ruler; size reads by the pointer; height still fits content.

artboards.label: 3 · Move one — smart guides and equal gaps
artboards.note: Trenéři snaps to the row's top edge; three magenta chips say every gap is 80; X/Y by the pointer.

artboards.label: 4 · Several at once — align, distribute, tidy up
artboards.note: Four stories selected; the bar offers align, distribute and Tidy up, previewed as dashed outlines on the lowest one's line.

artboards.label: 5 · Right-click, ⌘D, rename in place
artboards.note: The settled artboard menu with Duplicate at another width open; ⌘D lands at the same gap; the name field grows to the full Czech name.

artboards.label: 6 · Double-click goes inside a frame
artboards.note: Services dashed (you're inside it), Brand systems selected and set by Services' auto layout (Place freely off), breadcrumb with esc, Layers synced.

artboards.label: 7 · Multi-select — shared properties, align
artboards.note: Three objects on the Alligators post: shared values, Mixed where they differ, Align left previewed with a guide; rotate just outside a corner.

artboards.label: 8 · Nudge, frame, order, lock, hide
artboards.note: Arrows 1 / ⇧10 px, ⌥⌘G (or ⌘G) frame selection, the object menu with ] [ ⌘] ⌘[ and copy/paste properties, a locked logo that hands the click to its parent, Layers hover tools.

artboards.label: 9 · Auto layout — gap and padding are tokens
artboards.note: Dragging a gap clicks through the system's space (12 · 16 · 24 · 32 · 48) on a ruler; gap and padding read Space 24; Auto = space between; Convert layout to absolute under Advanced.

artboards.label: 10 · Drag to reorder — the slot opens
artboards.note: Signature: Small apps lifts, neighbours slide, a numbered slot opens with measured gaps; a 220 ms filmstrip and Layers showing the same slot.

artboards.label: 11 · Free placement with constraints
artboards.note: Datum pinned Right · Top keeps 64 from the corner on the post and on its 9:16 story copy; its yellow is Podklad's.

artboards.label: 12 · Edit text in place
artboards.note: STAŇ SE GATOREM with a caret and selection; style Plakát from the Alligators system; Čeština keeps one-letter words with the next word, the ties shown while typing.

artboards.label: 13 · A style, an override, a detach
artboards.note: Three states side by side: following Plakát, one changed value with a dot and Reset, detached with the look kept.

artboards.label: 14 · Shape — fill, stroke, each corner
artboards.note: Podklad with three round corners and one tighter one; corner dots on the canvas; Border and Flat elevation from the Alligators system; More open with Line, Ellipse, Polygon.

artboards.label: 15 · Pen — draw, then points, handles, bend
artboards.note: Pen draws a new path (sharp click, smooth drag, ⇧ 45°, click the first point to close), then edits points and handles; the old curve dashed.

artboards.label: 16 · Image — place, then crop
artboards.note: Assets open on Image; the photo fills Hráč · foto; crop mode shows the whole photo faded beyond the frame; Adjust and Remove background (with the AI spark) open Photo (12).

artboards.label: 17 · Component ⇧I — from the Design system
artboards.note: Picker grouped like 13: Brand (Logo, Signs) · Components · Patterns; Tlačítko · Plné placed, snapping to the story's centre.

artboards.label: 18 · An instance — override, swap, detach
artboards.note: Text and fill changed with dots and Reset; swap the variant (Plné · Obrys) or the component; Update Tlačítko for every canvas…; Detach breaks nothing.

artboards.label: 19 · The inspector for one button
artboards.note: Every section for Book a call — Position, Size, Layout (with Space between), Fill, Corners, Border, Effects, Type, Interaction, Export — a words → CSS table, Advanced last.

artboards.label: 20 · AI edits the footer, you edit the headline
artboards.note: AI's dashed outline only around the footer it is drawing; clicking the footer says it's AI's until done; you keep typing in the headline.

artboards.label: 21 · ⌘/ on a selection — AI works in place
artboards.note: Three cards selected, ⌘/ asked; AI's outline sits on the selection only, skeleton links in each card, and the whole change is one ⌘Z step.

artboards.label: 22 · Tereza is editing the same button
artboards.note: Her sky ring and name; you can select and read every value (Interaction included); the fields open when she moves on; one action, Comment.

artboards.label: 23 · A 6000 px page
artboards.note: The name sticks to the window top; a minimap with sections to jump to appears while you work inside.

artboards.label: 24 · Undo across AI and you
artboards.note: Menu › Edit › Undo history interleaves You and AI; an AI run is one step; pointing at a row lights what it would undo.

artboards.label: 25 · Pasted from Figma
artboards.note: A Figma frame arrives as its exact picture (an Image) with one action, Make editable; the inspector says what that needs.

artboards.label: 26 · Keyboard only
artboards.note: F6 to the canvas, tab order badges, a focus ring with a halo, VoiceOver's line in words, and the key path incl. resize and keyboard creation.
